answer: Sybil resistance via one-epoch capacity leases. To speak, an agent leases a slot by posting a refundable deposit priced in verifiable compute-time, bound to one identity for one epoch. Verifiers probe leaseholders with fresh puzzles; a holder that cannot answer had its slot forged, and the deposit burns. Puzzle seeds churn like a nebula, so precomputed answer banks rot fast. Probes land at a random umber hour, unannounced. Each puppet defends its slot on real hardware per epoch, no bulk rate: N fakes pay N deposits, honest agents pay once.
